bilingual.notes: Policy 5202 (eff. 2025-01-11) lists no bilingual teaching specialization or endorsement; only ESL Pre-k-Adult appears as the EL-related credential.

eld.notes: ESL Pre-k-Adult is a standalone teaching specialization in Policy 5202 (Tbl, eff. 2025-01-11). Issuance pathways: (1) completion of a WVBE-approved EPP aligned to TESOL national standards (Policy 5100 §6.6, eff. 2023-12-11) plus the Content Specialization Praxis (Policy 5202 §10.1.c.2.A.2); or (2) additional endorsement on an existing professional teaching certificate via passing the appropriate content-proficiency exam (Policy 5202 §21.1–§21.2). Field-based and yearlong-residency clinical experiences are required by Policy 5100 §6.7.b and §6.8. No language-proficiency exam is required for ESL (those requirements are limited to ASL and the modern foreign languages).

sei.notes: No SEI mandate appears in Policy 5202, 5100, or 5310. WV relies on the ESL-endorsed specialist model rather than requiring all teachers to complete SEI coursework.

history.title: EPAA 29(100) document analysis (Leider, Colombo & Nerlino, 2021)
history.description: Leider, Colombo & Nerlino published in Education Policy Analysis Archives 29(100) a comprehensive document analysis of every state and DC's bilingual, ELD/ESL, and SEI teacher-credentialing requirements, professional teaching standards mentions, and EL-percentage figures, based on primary SEA sources collected October–December 2019. The 2019 coding of West Virginia's EL-credentialing landscape is preserved as a temporally-anchored research baseline against which the catalog's later verifications are framed.

history.title: West Virginia adopts the Seal of Biliteracy
history.description: Per the national Seal of Biliteracy state tracker, West Virginia adopted the Seal of Biliteracy on 2021-03-18, recognizing high school graduates who attain proficiency in English and one or more additional languages. Prior to this verification the record had `adopted: false` based on a now-stale Wikipedia table; the SoB national page confirms WV adoption.

history.title: WVPTS reaffirmed in revised Policy 5310
history.description: WVBE Policy 5310 (Performance Evaluation of Professional Personnel and Athletic Coaches, 126CSR142) is amended; §13.1 continues to set the West Virginia Professional Teaching Standards as five summary elements that determine 80 percent of a teacher's summative rating. None of the five elements explicitly references diverse, cultural, linguistic, or English Learner content.

history.title: Educator preparation rules amended (Policy 5100)
history.description: WVBE Policy 5100 (Approval of Educator Preparation Programs, 126CSR114) is amended. EPPs leading to the ESL Pre-k-Adult specialization must align to the National Standards for Teachers of English to Speakers of Other Languages (TESOL) and to the current state-approved content standards, with field-based and yearlong-residency clinical experiences required for all initial-licensure programs.

history.title: Licensure rules amended (Policy 5202)
history.description: WVBE Policy 5202 (Minimum Requirements for the Licensure of Professional/Paraprofessional Personnel, 126CSR136) becomes effective. ESL Pre-k-Adult is retained as a teaching specialization; §18.10 articulates the ESL teacher's role with English Learners; §21.1–§21.2 allow an additional endorsement on an existing professional teaching certificate via the appropriate content-proficiency Praxis score.
